name: PALE THRONE: Neural Tile Conquest
subcategory: tile-laying strategy game with neural components
description: A high-end tile-laying conquest game where hexagonal physical tiles build a procedurally unique map each session, and BCI-equipped players receive private neural whispers — hidden strategic information delivered directly to their implant — about tile adjacency bonuses and hidden faction allegiances invisible on the physical surface. Non-BCI players play entirely from physical information; BCI players have informational advantages but are also vulnerable to 'neural bluff' tiles that feed false data directly into their implant. The game is published by a Spire-adjacent design house and retails as a luxury object.
story_hooks: A PALE THRONE tile set has been modified — the neural whispers it delivers are not game information but fragments of an encrypted message, and the full message only assembles if all twelve tiles in a specific expansion pack are played in the correct sequence.
The seizure incident was not a malfunction — someone deliberately introduced a hostile neural payload into a specific tile batch, and the corporate retreat victim was the intended target.

An unaugmented player has been winning every PALE THRONE tournament they enter, and the BCI-equipped players are furious — their neural whispers are being intercepted and fed back as noise, and only this one player seems to know how.
